excerpt_i18n.en: On July 30, local time, OpenAI announced optimizations to the pricing and performance of its GPT-5.6 series models to improve cost-effectiveness for enterprise AI applications. These price cuts will also be reflected in the paid subscription credit calculations when using Codex and ChatGPT Work. Additionally, OpenAI launched a Fast mode in the API, replacing the previous Priority Processing service. In Fast mode, GPT-5.6 Sol can achieve processing speeds up to 2.5 times that of the standard mode, at twice the price of the standard mode, while model capabilities remain unchanged. (Jiemian)
excerpt_i18n.es: El 30 de julio, hora local, OpenAI anunció la optimización de los precios y el rendimiento de la serie de modelos GPT-5.6 para mejorar la relación calidad-precio de las aplicaciones de IA para empresas. Entre ellos, el precio del modelo GPT-5.6 Luna se reduce en un 80%, y el del modelo GPT-5.6 Terra en un 20%. Esta reducción también se reflejará en el cálculo de las cuotas de suscripción de pago al usar Codex y ChatGPT Work. excerpt_i18n.en: On July 29, XtalPi officially launched the XtalPi Science AI for Science platform and the Genius Agents scientific agent matrix, and jointly initiated the establishment of the "Open Ecosystem Alliance for AI for Science" with 26 industrial, academic, and research ecosystem partners. The alliance will leverage XtalPi Science to provide members with diverse collaboration models, including access to platform and automated experimental resources, model and tool integration, joint development, and private deployment, thereby promoting efficient synergy among models, data, tools, and experimental capabilities. XtalPi Science is the world's first comprehensive AI for Science (AI4S) platform that integrates large language models (LLMs), scientific agents, and large-scale automated robotic experiments. It encapsulates XtalPi's decade-long accumulation of models, tools, agents, and experimental resources into on-demand Science Tokens, transforming from an internal system serving single projects into a globally available AI4S infrastructure (Global Scientific Utility) that can be accessed by research organizations worldwide. Genius Agents, as the core scheduling hub and development matrix of the entire system, builds a multi-agent system with both global planning and specific scenario execution capabilities. It can autonomously understand complex scientific goals, complete interdisciplinary long-range tasks, and significantly reduce model hallucinations.
